responsibility: Adds the small rs6000 target-macro hook that reports whether the Xilinx auxiliary floating-point unit is enabled. Its sole job is to override TARGET_XILINX_FPU so backend code and surrounding configuration can gate behavior on the rs6000_xilinx_fpu option state, acting as the configuration companion to the Xilinx APU floating-point support files.
same_name_distinction: Unlike xfpu.md, this header does not describe the Xilinx FPU pipeline; it only overrides TARGET_XILINX_FPU to test the rs6000_xilinx_fpu option so other rs6000 configuration code can detect whether the auxiliary FPU is enabled.
